name: The Seagrass Meadows
riddle: Three stars below each keep a mark; set the dials true, and the stone will part.

steps.objective: Set the three dials to the marks the sea has kept.
Take what lies behind the door.

hints: Three dials, three kinds of mark: numbers, letters and signs. Somewhere in the meadow, three big starfish each carry one of them on their backs.
Each starfish frames its mark in a shape. Look at the middle of each dial.
One marked starfish lies where the current won't let you swim up. Grip the turtle's shell and hold on.

reward.nextRiddle: When noon's light swims through the door, blue shows the way the old ones swore.
reward.message: Map piece III! The way to the Blue Grotto is open.
